title: Badhaai Ho Badhaai
desc: Anjali and Anthony elope, marrying despite their parents' anger. Twenty-seven years later, a young man claiming to be their son arrives, hoping to heal the rift between their families.

title: Phone Bhoot
desc: Two young men start a ghost-catching business inspired by childhood stories. Their work turns dangerous when they must face a poltergeist and keep a promise that could cost them dearly.

title: Race 3
desc: While executing their biggest heist, a criminal family uncovers shocking truths that put their relationships and loyalties to the ultimate test.

title: Don 2
desc: After ruling the Asian underworld, Don targets Europe's criminal scene. Trapped between the Berlin mafia and relentless law enforcement, he fights to survive betrayal.

title: Koogle Kuttappa
desc: A conservative villager opposes his son's move to Russia for work, but when the son brings home a robot caregiver, he forms an unexpected bond with the machine.

title: Om Jai Jagdish
desc: Three brothers put aside their differences to join forces and save their ancestral home from being auctioned, resolving their family's legacy and their own personal issues.

title: Safar
desc: In love with Neela, Avinash urges her to wed another man, sacrificing his own happiness. The fragile marriage unravels when her husband grows suspicious of Avinash.

title: Parichay
desc: Jobless Ravi accepts the daunting task of tutoring five spoiled children who chased away every teacher, but soon wins their trust and falls in love with Rama, the eldest.

title: Jodi No.1
desc: Partners in crime Jai and Veeru set their next target on a rich businessman, Rai Bahadur. Things turn hilarious when both of them fall for his daughters.

title: Tapasya
desc: Indu, eldest daughter of a sick man, falls for her father's doctor. But her lover's mother demands she abandon her family and place her in-laws above all else.

title: Gold
desc: Tapan Das managed India's hockey team after independence. He faces many challenges as he fights to lead the team to win an Olympic gold medal for the nation.

title: Akele Hum Akele Tum
desc: Rohit and Kiran, aspiring singers, fall in love and marry. But responsibilities weigh heavily, straining their bond until Kiran decides to leave, breaking Rohit's heart and dreams.

title: Bawaal
desc: A small-town boy falls in love with the most beautiful girl in town. He eventually gets married to her only because he realises that their marriage can help him climb the social ladder.

title: Trimurti
desc: Falsely accused and jailed, Satyadevi hopes her three sons will free her and avenge her. But she discovers they live separate lives and despise one another.
